wod.title: Power Clean, Front Squat, Pendlay Row & Engine EMOM

parts.name: Build a
parts.prescription:
E1.5 x 6
2 BB Power Clean + 2 Front Squat @ 75%

parts.name: Build b
parts.prescription:
Heavy BB "Pendlay" Row - Descending reps: 8-8-6-6 (Go heavier each set)
b/t sets: 30's Heavy Plank Hold

parts.name: Engine
parts.prescription:
20min EMOM (5 rounds)
1st min - 8 Burpees
2nd min - 16 Russian KB Swings
3rd min - 24 Sit-ups
4th min - 64 Double Unders

targets.why: Preps front squat depth in A and double under bounding in C
Essential for front rack hold in A and posture in B
Primes hinge for power cleans in A and KB swings in C
Stabilizes plank holds in B and burpee press in C

blocks.name: General Flow & Temperature
items: 2 rounds: 30s single unders or jumping jacks, 30s bird-dogs
10 alternating world's greatest stretches with thoracic rotation
10 air squats with a 2-second pause in the bottom

blocks.name: Mobility & Positional Activation
items: 8 banded ankle rocks per side over toes
8 deep squat pry stretches with active tall chest
10 PVC front rack elbow rotations per side
10 light Russian kettlebell swings focusing on snap

blocks.name: Barbell Specific Primer
items: 5 empty bar clean deadlifts + 5 hang muscle cleans
5 front squats with slow tempo and high elbows
5 Pendlay rows focusing on flat back and bar path
3 power cleans + 2 front squats at light working prep

rx.line: E1.5M x 6: 2 Power Cleans + 2 Front Squats @ 75%

scaled.line: E1.5M x 6: 2 Hang Power Cleans + 2 Front Squats @ moderate load

senior.line: E1.5M x 6: 2 Dumbbell Hang Cleans + 2 DB Goblet Squats (light-moderate)

cues: Keep elbows fast and high on both the clean catch and the front squats.
Maintain a tight midsection and upright torso when driving out of the squat.

faults.fault: Catching cleans with elbows down, dropping forward in squats
faults.fix: Rotate elbows high and fast into the front rack before descending.

substitutions: Dumbbells or kettlebells for wrist/shoulder mobility limits.

rx.line: Pendlay Row 8-8-6-6 (build to heavy) / b/t sets: 30s Weighted Plank Hold

scaled.line: Barbell Bent-Over Row 8-8-6-6 (moderate) / b/t sets: 30s Plank Hold

senior.line: DB Chest-Supported or Bent Row 8-8-8-8 / b/t sets: 20-30s Elevated Plank

cues: Reset bar on the floor each rep of Pendlay rows; keep spine flat.
Squeeze shoulder blades at top without using excessive hip kick.

faults.fault: Rounding low back or jerking chest upright to lift load
faults.fix: Hinge hips deep, brace abdomen, and pull strictly with back and arms.

substitutions: Chest-supported dumbbell rows to protect lower back.

rx.line: EMOM 20: 8 Burpees / 16 Russian Swings (24/16kg) / 24 Sit-ups / 64 Double Unders

scaled.line: EMOM 20: 6 Burpees / 14 Russian Swings (16/12kg) / 18 Sit-ups / 45 Single Unders

senior.line: EMOM 20: 5 Elevated Burpees / 12 Light Swings / 12 Sit-ups / 30 Plate Hops

rxPlus.line: EMOM 20: 10 Burpees / 20 Russian Swings (32/24kg) / 20 GHD Sit-ups / 75 Double Unders

cues: Aim for 15-20s of rest every minute; pace reps steadily from minute 1.
Snap hips powerfully on swings so arms guide the kettlebell effortlessly.

faults.fault: Squatting the kettlebell swing instead of hinging at the hips
faults.fix: Push hips back with soft knees and snap glutes forward to float bell.

substitutions: Plate hops or bike calories for double unders to accommodate ankles.

injuries.label: Ankle
injuries.warmup: Replace jumping with easy bike erg; keep ankle mobilizations strictly pain-free.

parts.suggestion: Hang power clean into box squat; reduce load and avoid aggressive foot stomp.
As written if pain-free; maintain flat foot stance without heel lift.
Step-back burpees without jumping; sub double unders with low-impact bike erg.

injuries.label: Shoulder
injuries.warmup: Skip overhead PVC work; do light band pull-aparts and gentle unweighted mobility.

parts.suggestion: Clean deadlifts + front squat with crossed-arm grip or safety squat bar if needed.
Lighter Pendlay rows or chest-supported rows; sub plank hold with hollow hold.
No-pushup burpees to a box; light Russian swings below eye level or KB deadlifts.

blocks.label: A. Build a: Clean & Front Squat
B. Build b: Pendlay Row & Plank
